sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा महातेजा विरराम महामुनिः ।साधु साधु इति ते सर्वे मुनयो हि अभ्यपूजयन् ॥१-३४-१९॥
transliteration: evam uktvā mahātejā virarāma mahāmuniḥ ।sādhu sādhu iti te sarve munayo hi abhyapūjayan ॥1-34-19॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus the highly lustrous, great ascetic rested. All sages praised him, saying, "wellsaid wellsaid"
